description: Single source of truth for LumaWeave doc cluster color values. Frontmatter cluster: values reference these names; the hex values resolve to actual rendered colors in consumer surfaces (radial inspector, doc nav, future customization UI).
naming: Color names are descriptive (gold, azure) not semantic (theme, graph). This decouples color choice from concept naming so renaming a domain does not require a color migration. The 'domain' field on each entry is informational only.

customization.today: Edit this file directly to change color values. Frontmatter does not change.
customization.soon: loadClusterColors() utility + CSS custom property bridge (--cluster-<name>).
customization.later: User-facing color picker UI; per-user overrides via theme override storage; per-theme cluster color variants.
